propositions: The completion_floor feature is fully implemented and calibrated (30/30 gold-set decisions correct, κ=1.0) but has never been enabled in production; it must be activated via verify.completion_floor_active=true in the project rebar.toml while preserving schema default False for other clients.

Completion-floor suppressions are persisted to the plan-review sidecar dropped[] array tagged with drop_reason=completion; operators must be able to audit and recover wrongly-suppressed findings via the sidecar without opening code or logs.

The completion floor must execute live on real plan-reviews in this project without changing PASS/BLOCK verdicts; a live run demonstrates the floor no-ops when no qualifying findings exist (fail-safe-to-keep behavior) and verdict remains unchanged.
Current successful-floor-drop path logs nothing; adding an INFO line at the drop site enables live suppression visibility without requiring sidecar inspection.

Rollback risk is bounded: the floor is advisory-only, container-only, gated by five-condition conjunction, and fail-safe; a wrong suppression cannot alter verdicts and is always recoverable from the sidecar.
